text:
deploy-bot: Canary alert: release 2.8.0 -> us-east-1 slice 8% breached p95 latency (420ms > 300ms). Auto-rollback in 4m unless acknowledged. :rotating_light:

elaine.prod: saw the spike on dashboards. Noticed request shapes with long context.

omar-sre: tagging @jen-releases. Can we avoid full rollback? We could shrink slice and run a flag flip.

jen-releases: two quick options: reduce to 1% and acknowledge, or rollback to 2.7.3. Which is faster?

elain.prod: shrink to 1% and ack so eng can triage. Runbook command?

ops-runner: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.8.0 --slice us-east-1 --percent 1` then `deploy-bot ack --by elaine.prod --duration 20m`.

omar-sre: applied traffic set -> 1%. deploy-bot acked; hold until 1760006760.

jen-releases: looking at change: build enabled `attn_opt=true`. If toggleable, try flipping for the slice.

elain.prod: go ahead with a scoped toggle on staging then production probe. If probe passes, ramp slowly.

ops-runner: toggle command: `releasesctl flag set --release 2.8.0 --name attn_opt --value false --scope us-east-1` -> queued for probe.

deploy-bot: synthetic probe link: http://ci/probe/1760. Small run p95=290ms. No 5xx.

jen-releases: good. ramp to 5% over 8m and monitor. Fallback: `releasesctl rollback --from 2.8.0 --to 2.7.3 --regions us-east-1 --mode immediate` if regression returns.

omar-sre: ramp executed to 5%. Monitoring shows p95 ~305ms. Stable.

elain.prod: drafting short note for #customer-ops: "We temporarily reduced rollout in us-east-1 for latency checks; no customer action required."

jen-releases: create follow-up ticket REL-5333 to gate attn_opt behind extended preflight.

deploy-bot: Final: auto-rollback suppressed; no rollback executed. Handoff to REL-5333. Thread archived.
